name: After recital 4
title: REPORT on the proposal for a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council suspending the application of the rules on the appointment of authorised representatives for extended producer responsibility for waste, waste electrical and electronical equipment and single use plastic waste
part_text: (4a) The suspension introduced by this Directive should be limited to the administrative requirement concerning the appointment of an authorised representative and should not affect any other obligations of producers with regards to extended producer responsibility or any environmental objectives set out in Union law.
